items.question: How do I join a tournament?
items.answer: Choose a tournament and complete the individual player entry form. The tournament desk reviews your entry and confirms payment manually.

items.question: Is tournament entry paid?
items.answer: Yes. Each tournament is paid entry. The entry details are shown on the tournament card before you submit.

items.question: What squad format is used?
items.answer: MasterGaming.pk tournaments use a 4-player squad format unless the tournament listing says otherwise.
